text:
Anya: Morning all — follow-up on RFC. Proposing a 'graft & harvest' incremental refactor pattern: create tiny adapter grafts at hotpath edges, stabilize, then prune monolith. Lower blast radius and faster rollback.
Mike: Outline phases?
Anya: Phase 1: identify 4–6 low-risk edges (enricher, tenant routing, session stitch, model-profile lookup). Implement graft proxies that translate requests to existing runtime. Phase 2: shadow traffic + routing tests, move tests/telemetry. Phase 3: flip traffic and prune old code.
Sam: Stateful concerns (session store, kv-cache)?
Anya: Grafts should be stateless. For stateful items, use sidecar proxies that talk to current backends. No schema writes in Phase 1.
Jess: Product ask: customer impact windows?
Anya: Target zero visible impact. Canaries outside peak, weighted feature-flag rollouts, immediate fallback to monolith.
Raj: Latency budget for inference hotpaths?
Mike: Realistic addl latency from TLS + proxy ~3ms; set worst-case budget 10ms.
Anya: Agreed. Bypass graft for ultra-low-latency calls; enable batching knobs for non-critical flows.
Sam: Tracing propagation?
Anya: Preserve trace ids — use X-Request-Trace header and emit preflight spans. Add shim extractor in graft.
Mike: Ownership?
Anya: eng-runtime owns graft templates and infra; individual service teams own grafts. If ambiguous, one-month rotation owner.
Jess: CI/testing?
Anya: New graft-smoke job in CI that runs end-to-end in staging against 3 profiles. Example validation:
```bash
curl -H "X-Feature: graft-tenant-routing" "https://staging.graft.internal/api/v1/route?tenant=acme"
```
Sam: Need perf synthetic for token-cost and KV warm/cold.
Raj: Model-profile interactions: read-only cached copy in graft; fallback to control plane API. No writes.
Mike: DB migration plan? Two-step safe delete: stop writes -> read-only window -> prune. Separate RFC per table.
Anya: No destructive changes during initial harvest stages.
Jess: Rollback?
Anya: Feature-flag off + flip weights back to monolith. `scripts/flip-traffic.sh` for ops. Console to expose per-tenant weight controls.
Sam: Observability gates?
Anya: Temporary canary SLOs: p95 latency increase <= 20% and errors < 0.1%. Breach auto-rollback. Add delta alerts for p50/p95 and error-rate.
Raj: Security review before Phase 1 merges. No new key material in grafts initially.
Mike: Timeline?
Anya: Kickoff Monday. Phase 1 = 3 sprints, Phase 2 = 2 sprints, Phase 3 = 4+ sprints depending on harvest complexity.
Jess: Dependencies: console controls, tracing shim, CI job, perf harness. Who's tracking?
Anya: I'll own main epic and create sub-epics per graft; assign leads at planning.
Mike: +1 incremental approach.
Jess: +1 product.
Raj: +1 ML; will flag model rollouts early.
Anya: I'll write an RFC doc with sequence diagrams and a checklist. Thanks.
deploy-bot: Started graft-tenant-routing canary on staging (job graft-canary-202603).
deploy-bot: Canary metrics: p50 +2ms, p95 +9ms, errors 0.03% — within gates.
